coverage.assessment: Tuppence's 'But it's no good' now has no list of failed efforts to contrast with. The 'difference' retort and the later 'five shillings' have lost their setups, both from the first draft. The Jane Finn plant and the general/bicycle-shop pair are intact.
Cutting the walk down Dover Street gives Tommy two back-to-back speeches at the Tube exit, and the next location is simply 'Lyons''. Lyons', the park and the meeting place remain clear.
Tommy's 'Young Adventurers, Ltd.?' is fused with his practical question, which removes Tuppence's 'something in it' reply. Other speakers are correctly attributed.
The compressed biography drops the Government office and the post-Armistice combing-out. 'Since then' now implies she has been job-hunting since driving the general. This is minor.
No romance hint is added, and Tommy's blush is even removed. Jane Finn is passed over as the plan requires, and nothing is disclosed early.
Slang and the mock-formal labels survive ('Mr. Beresford magnificently'). Several of the small poverty jokes and the narrator's irony are trimmed.
The three ways to money, her marry-money and anti-sentiment creed, the moral-guilt joke and the joint venture are all stated plainly, as the plan requires.

All six local endpoints survive. The uncle dependency is weakened by the cut spite line. In 016 the partner line 'I've always jumped on sentiment' is gone, but 'false to your principles' still carries the echo.

strengths: The opening greeting and the 'united ages... forty-five' joke are preserved intact, so the comic register is set immediately.
The Jane Finn remark stays casual and is cut off by Tuppence seizing a seat, so the plant works without any signalling.
The ad-drafting sequence keeps Tommy as the source of the 'unreasonable' twist, Tuppence's 'if pay is good' and his deflating 'hoax... lunatic' reply.
The general and bicycle-shop joke stays attached after the optional rich-girl exchange is cut, as the plan specifies.
The ending keeps the economy walk and the verbatim cliffhanger, which hands off cleanly to 003.
summary: The revision keeps every essential beat and all eight verbatim lines, including the toque, the hospital reunion, the Jane Finn plant, the bicycle-shop payoff, the joint venture and the cliffhanger. Its new cuts leave a few small problems: a dangling 'But', a merged Tommy turn that skips Tuppence's earnest reply, the uncle's spite toward Tommy's mother that the Savoy reconciliation relies on, and the walk from the Tube. It also thins the shabby-genteel texture. Two minor residues come from the first draft. Nothing is a blocker.
